lead.body: erkamyaman/rust-anything is today's fastest-growing repository on GitHub, gaining 1,876 stars in the last day to reach 4,064 total. Rewrite your whole app in Rust, one piece at a time, checked against the original's recorded behavior at every step. CLIs, HTTP servers and libraries in TypeScript, Python, C, Go, Ruby and Java.
